body.intent: Generate a reusable Luau function: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.

artifact.name: celsius_to_fahrenheit
artifact.content:
local function celsius_to_fahrenheit(c: number): number
    -- Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit using the exact formula
    return c * 9 / 5 + 32
end
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
local f = celsius_to_fahrenheit(input.celsius)
return { fahrenheit = f }
end
artifact.description: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need to convert a numeric temperature in Celsius to Fahrenheit.

Return notified (ids whose send succeeded, in list order), failed (ids whose send failed) and count (= number notified). If listing fails, return {error, message} from the tool. tools.message.send may be called at most 10 times per execution.
